import os
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
os.environ["TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL"] = "3"
import tensorflow as tf
tf.config.set_visible_devices([], "GPU")
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds
builder = tfds.builder_from_directory("/mnt/Projects_origin/VLA-Adapter/data/robotwin_rlds/grasp_conveyor_block_2/1.0.0")
ds = builder.as_dataset(split="train")
ep = next(iter(ds))
steps = ep["steps"]
# file_path may be episode metadata
print("episode keys", ep.keys())
if "episode_metadata" in ep:
    meta = ep["episode_metadata"]
    print("meta keys", meta.keys())
    for k in meta:
        v = meta[k]
        if hasattr(v, "numpy"):
            v = v.numpy()
        print(k, v if not hasattr(v, "shape") else (v.shape, str(v)[:200]))
# first step language
s0 = next(iter(steps))
print("step keys", s0.keys())
print("lang", s0["language_instruction"].numpy()[:200])
print("action", s0["action"].numpy().shape, s0["action"].numpy()[:14] if s0["action"].numpy().ndim else s0["action"].numpy())
print("obs keys", s0["observation"].keys())
if "file_path" in s0["observation"]:
    print("obs file_path", s0["observation"]["file_path"].numpy())
PY
